title: "Error analysis: which sites does the model get wrong?"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-20"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```


```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)
library(pROC)
library(PRROC)

MODEL <- 2      # 2 = Dorado probabilities only (main analysis); set to 3 to repeat for Model 3

# Colours: correct predictions grey, errors purple (distinct from the blue/orange class colours)
OUT_COLS <- c(Correct = "#a6a6a6", Error = "#7b3294")
CLASS_COLS <- c("GLORI m6A" = "#2b7bb9", "GLORI unmodified" = "#d9603b")
GROUP_LEVELS <- c("TP", "FN", "TN", "FP")

# ---- model predictions (written by the model script) ----
pred <- fread(sprintf("test_predictions_model%d.tsv", MODEL)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% mutate(start = as.integer(start))

# ---- test features, including ones the model did not use ----
feat <- fread("final_test_feature_matrix_fixed.tsv") %>% as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(start = as.integer(start)) %>%
  select(chrom, start, strand,
         any_of(c("coverage", "modified_percent", "mod_prob_median", "mod_prob_q25",
                  "mod_prob_q75", "mod_prob_sd", "base_qual_q25", "base_qual_q50",
                  "base_qual_q75", "kmer_5mer")))

# ---- GLORI annotations: methylation level and transcript region ----
read_glori <- function(path) {
  g <- fread(path)
  if ("seqnames" %in% names(g)) setnames(g, "seqnames", "chrom")
  as_tibble(g)
}
gpos <- read_glori("same_transcript_positives.csv")
gneg <- read_glori("GLORI_HEK293T_all_negatives_gt100_compact.csv")

pos_ann <- gpos %>% transmute(chrom, start = as.integer(start), strand,
  glori_ratio = Ratio_mean,
  region = if ("feature" %in% names(gpos)) as.character(feature) else NA_character_)
neg_ann <- gneg %>% transmute(chrom, start = as.integer(start), strand,
  glori_ratio = rowMeans(cbind(Ratio_rep1, Ratio_rep2), na.rm = TRUE),
  region = if ("feature" %in% names(gneg)) as.character(feature) else NA_character_)
ann <- bind_rows(pos_ann, neg_ann) %>% distinct(chrom, start, strand, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- merge everything ----
df <- pred %>%
  left_join(feat, by = c("chrom", "start", "strand")) %>%
  left_join(ann,  by = c("chrom", "start", "strand")) %>%
  mutate(class   = if_else(label == 1, "GLORI m6A", "GLORI unmodified"),
         outcome = if_else(group %in% c("TP", "TN"), "Correct", "Error"),
         group   = factor(group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS))

# checks: nothing lost, nothing unmatched
stopifnot(nrow(df) == nrow(pred))
cat("Sites:", nrow(df), "\n")
print(table(df$group))
cat("Missing features:", sum(is.na(df$coverage)),
    "| missing GLORI level:", sum(is.na(df$glori_ratio)), "\n")

write_tsv(df, sprintf("error_analysis_table_model%d.tsv", MODEL))
```

## 1. Where do the errors sit on the probability scale?

```{r prob-dist, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.8}
p_prob <- ggplot(df, aes(x = prob, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, boundary = 0, colour = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_sqrt() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = OUT_COLS, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Predicted probability of m6A", y = "Number of sites (square-root scale)",
       title = sprintf("Model %d: predicted probabilities by GLORI class", MODEL)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_prob
ggsave(sprintf("err_prob_distribution_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_prob, width = 9, height = 3.8)
```

## 2. GLORI methylation level vs DRS modified fraction

False negatives at low GLORI levels = Dorado misses weakly methylated sites.
False negatives at high GLORI levels = genuine Dorado failures worth inspecting.

```{r glori-vs-drs, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
p_scatter <- df %>% arrange(outcome) %>%            # draw errors on top
  ggplot(aes(x = 100 * glori_ratio, y = modified_percent, colour = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = OUT_COLS, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "GLORI methylation level (%)", y = "DRS modified fraction (%, modkit)",
       title = "Agreement between GLORI and DRS methylation levels") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_scatter
ggsave(sprintf("err_glori_vs_drs_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_scatter, width = 10, height = 4.5)

# GLORI level of missed vs found positives
df %>% filter(class == "GLORI m6A") %>% group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_glori_pct = 100 * median(glori_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            share_below_20pct = mean(glori_ratio < 0.20, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## 3. Error rate per 5-mer

Only 5-mers with at least 30 sites in a class. Stars mark 5-mers whose error rate differs
from the rest of that class (Fisher's exact test, BH-adjusted p < 0.05).

```{r kmer, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
kmer_err <- df %>%
  group_by(class, kmer_5mer) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_err = sum(outcome == "Error"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  mutate(tot = sum(n), tot_err = sum(n_err)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n >= 30) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p = fisher.test(matrix(c(n_err, n - n_err,
                                  tot_err - n_err, (tot - n) - (tot_err - n_err)),
                                nrow = 2))$p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
         rate = n_err / n, overall = tot_err / tot) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(key = paste(kmer_5mer, class, sep = "__"),
         key = fct_reorder(key, rate),
         lab = paste0("n=", n, if_else(p_adj < 0.05, " *", "")))

p_kmer <- ggplot(kmer_err, aes(x = 100 * rate, y = key)) +
  geom_col(fill = OUT_COLS["Error"], width = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 100 * overall), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free",
             labeller = as_labeller(c("GLORI m6A" = "False-negative rate (GLORI m6A sites)",
                                      "GLORI unmodified" = "False-positive rate (GLORI unmodified sites)"))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("__.*", "", x)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = "Error rate (%)", y = "5-mer context",
       title = "Error rate by sequence context (dashed line = overall rate)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
p_kmer
ggsave(sprintf("err_kmer_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_kmer, width = 10, height = 6)

kmer_err %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  select(class, kmer_5mer, n, n_err, rate, overall, p_adj) %>% arrange(class, p_adj)
```

## 4. Error rate by coverage

```{r coverage, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.8}
cov_err <- df %>%
  mutate(cov_bin = cut(coverage, breaks = c(10, 20, 50, 100, Inf), right = FALSE,
                       labels = c("10–19", "20–49", "50–99", "≥100"))) %>%
  group_by(class, cov_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(outcome == "Error"), .groups = "drop")

p_cov <- ggplot(cov_err, aes(x = cov_bin, y = 100 * rate, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CLASS_COLS, name = NULL,
                    labels = c("False-negative rate (m6A)", "False-positive rate (unmodified)")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "DRS read coverage", y = "Error rate (%)", title = "Error rate by read coverage") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_cov
ggsave(sprintf("err_coverage_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_cov, width = 8, height = 3.8)
```

## 5. Feature distributions: errors vs correct predictions

```{r boxplots, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
long <- df %>%
  transmute(group, class,
            `log10 coverage`             = log10(coverage),
            `Median base quality`        = base_qual_q50,
            `SD of m6A probability`      = mod_prob_sd,
            `Median m6A probability`     = mod_prob_median,
            `DRS modified fraction (%)`  = modified_percent,
            `GLORI methylation (%)`      = 100 * glori_ratio) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(group, class), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")

p_box <- ggplot(long, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(TP = "#2b7bb9", FN = "#9ecae1", TN = "#d9603b", FP = "#fdae6b"),
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Features of correct and incorrect predictions") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_box
ggsave(sprintf("err_boxplots_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_box, width = 11, height = 6)

# Wilcoxon tests: FN vs TP and FP vs TN
wilcox_tab <- long %>%
  mutate(comparison = case_when(group %in% c("TP", "FN") ~ "FN vs TP",
                                group %in% c("TN", "FP") ~ "FP vs TN")) %>%
  group_by(comparison, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    median_correct = median(value[group %in% c("TP", "TN")], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_error   = median(value[group %in% c("FN", "FP")], na.rm = TRUE),
    p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(value[group %in% c("FN", "FP")],
                             value[group %in% c("TP", "TN")])$p.value,
                 error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
print(wilcox_tab, n = Inf)
write_tsv(wilcox_tab, sprintf("err_wilcoxon_model%d.tsv", MODEL))
```

## 6. Error rate by transcript region (if annotated)

```{r region, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.8}
if (any(!is.na(df$region))) {
  reg_err <- df %>% filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
    group_by(class, region) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(outcome == "Error"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n >= 30)
  p_reg <- ggplot(reg_err, aes(x = region, y = 100 * rate, fill = class)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
              vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CLASS_COLS, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = "Transcript region", y = "Error rate (%)", title = "Error rate by transcript region") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p_reg)
  ggsave(sprintf("err_region_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_reg, width = 8, height = 3.8)
} else cat("No region annotation available.\n")
```

## 7. Which features pushed the errors the wrong way? (SHAP)

Mean per-site contribution (log-odds) of each feature, per prediction group.
Negative = pushed towards "unmodified", positive = towards "m6A".

```{r shap, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
contrib <- fread(sprintf("test_contributions_model%d.tsv", MODEL)) %>% as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(start = as.integer(start))
feat_cols <- setdiff(names(contrib), c("chrom", "start", "end", "strand", "BIAS", "(Intercept)"))

shap_mean <- contrib %>%
  inner_join(df %>% select(chrom, start, strand, group), by = c("chrom", "start", "strand")) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(feat_cols), names_to = "feature", values_to = "contribution") %>%
  group_by(group, feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_contrib = mean(contribution), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(feature) %>% filter(max(abs(mean_contrib)) > 0.05) %>% ungroup()

p_shap <- ggplot(shap_mean, aes(x = mean_contrib, y = fct_reorder(feature, abs(mean_contrib), max),
                                fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(TP = "#2b7bb9", FN = "#9ecae1", TN = "#d9603b", FP = "#fdae6b"),
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Mean contribution to prediction (log-odds)", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("Model %d: feature contributions by prediction group", MODEL)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_shap
ggsave(sprintf("err_shap_model%d.pdf", MODEL), p_shap, width = 9, height = 4)
```

## 8. ROC and precision-recall curves for all models

Uses every `test_predictions_model*.tsv` file that exists.

```{r curves, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
files <- list.files(pattern = "^test_predictions_model[0-9]\\.tsv$")
curves_roc <- list(); curves_pr <- list()
for (f in files) {
  m <- paste("Model", sub("\\D*(\\d).*", "\\1", f))
  d <- fread(f)
  r <- roc(d$label, d$prob, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  curves_roc[[m]] <- tibble(model = sprintf("%s (AUC %.3f)", m, auc(r)),
                            fpr = 1 - r$specificities, tpr = r$sensitivities)
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = d$prob[d$label == 1], scores.class1 = d$prob[d$label == 0],
                 curve = TRUE)
  curves_pr[[m]] <- tibble(model = sprintf("%s (AUC %.3f)", m, pr$auc.integral),
                           recall = pr$curve[, 1], precision = pr$curve[, 2])
}
baseline <- mean(fread(files[1])$label)

p_roc <- ggplot(bind_rows(curves_roc), aes(fpr, tpr, colour = model)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") + geom_path(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "False positive rate", y = "True positive rate", title = "ROC curves", colour = NULL)
p_pr <- ggplot(bind_rows(curves_pr), aes(recall, precision, colour = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Recall", y = "Precision", title = "Precision-recall curves", colour = NULL)

p_curves <- (p_roc | p_pr) &
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#555555", "#2b7bb9", "#7b3294")) &
  coord_equal() & theme_bw(base_size = 11) & theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")
p_curves
ggsave("roc_pr_curves.pdf", p_curves, width = 10, height = 5)
```
